title: "Image announcements"
format:
  revealjs:
    transition: none
---

## Mermaid

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Start] --> B[Middle] --> C[End]
```

## Image

![A caption]({{< placeholder 200 100 >}}){fig-alt="A grey rectangle"}

## Rating

```{=html}
<div role="img" aria-label="Rated 4 out of 5 stars">★★★★☆</div>
```

## Labelled chart

```{=html}
<span id="chart-name" hidden>Sales grew</span>
<span id="chart-period" hidden>every year</span>
<svg role="img" aria-labelledby="chart-name missing-label chart-period" aria-label="Ignored label" width="400" height="100">
  <title>Ignored title</title>
  <text x="20" y="50">2021 2022 2023 2024</text>
</svg>
```

## Titled chart

```{=html}
<svg role="img" width="400" height="100">
  <title>Sales increased</title>
  <text x="20" y="50">2021 2022</text>
</svg>
```

## Styled diagram

```{=html}
<svg width="400" height="100">
  <style style="display: inline">.announcement-node { fill: black; }</style>
  <script type="application/json" style="display: inline">{"notAnAnnouncement": true}</script>
  <text class="announcement-node" x="20" y="50">Start</text>
  <text class="announcement-node" x="200" y="50">End</text>
</svg>
```

## Decorative images

```{=html}
<img src="quarto.png" alt="">
<div role="img"><span>Unnamed image contents</span></div>
<div role="img" aria-hidden="true" aria-label="Hidden image">Hidden contents</div>
<div role="img" style="display: none" aria-label="Display-hidden image">Hidden contents</div>
```

## SVG titles

```{=html}
<svg width="400" height="100">
  <title>Graph</title>
  <g><title>Start to End</title><text x="20" y="50">Start</text><text x="200" y="50">End</text></g>
</svg>
```

## Label fallback

```{=html}
<div role="img" aria-labelledby="missing-name" aria-label="Fallback label">Ignored contents</div>
<div role="img" aria-labelledby="" aria-label="Empty-reference fallback">Ignored contents</div>
<img role="img" src="quarto.png" alt="Quarto logo">
```

## Fragment images

```{=html}
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="0">
  Parent image
  <img class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1" src="quarto.png" alt="Nested logo">
  <div class="fragment fade-out" data-fragment-index="2" role="img" aria-label="Initially visible rating">Ignored stars</div>
</div>
```
